sentences.text: This petition has been filed challenging the order passed by the Court below in Crl.M.P.No.7175 of 2022 dated 25.04.2023, dismissing the application filed under Section 311 of Cr.P.C., to recall the Inspector of Police, Komarapalayam Police Station for further examination.
2.Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the respondent.
3.The respondent has filed a private complaint against the petitioner for offence under Section 420 and 468 of IPC.
In the course of proceedings, the Inspector of Police of Komarapalayam Police Station was examined on the side of the petitioner.

The petitioner also took steps to get certain documents from the concerned police by filing an application under Section 91 of Cr.P.C., and this application came to be disposed of by the Court below on the ground that the concerned Police Station did not have any of those documents and it was all destroyed.

The petitioner wanted to elicit certain details from the Inspector of Police and hence, filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C., to recall the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Inspector of Police for further examination.

The Court below has dismissed this application only on the ground that no records are available in the Police Station and therefore, no useful purpose will be served in recalling the Inspector of Police.

sentences.text: petitioner is the complainant before the Court below and the petitioner wants to elicit certain facts from the Inspector of Police since the relevant documents are not available in the police station.
Hence, the petitioner must be given one opportunity to recall the Inspector of Police.
This is more so since the burden of proof is upon the petitioner to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt against the respondent.

5.In view of the above, the order passed in Crl.M.P.No.7175 of 2022, dated 25.04.2023, is hereby set aside and there shall be direction to the Court below to recall the Inspector of Police,
Komarapalayam Police Station for further examination.

It is made clear that the purpose of examination of Inspector of Police is not to seek for any documents and it is done only for eliciting certain facts from the Inspector of Police.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis N.ANAND VENKATESH, J ssr 6.Accordingly, this criminal original petition stands allowed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
